about: Every number this index ranks by, explained in README.md, How it scores; each verifier key's confidence is in lists/verifiers.json. Changing one changes every ranking. This is this index's opinion: another index ranks by other numbers. vouchStep: how much of what is left each full vouch keeps, in the vouch part. reportCut: what each full report leaves, in the report part. marketWeight: how much of the market's average search adds to each profile's ratings, for order only. tolerance and maxRounds: the ranking settles when nothing moves by more than tolerance, or after maxRounds rounds.
